purpose: Extend the four retained finite-cover certificates to explicit infinite sharp-four twist families, with uniform upper certificates and an invariant separating members. Audit the limited known-family implications without a global novelty claim.
construction: Induce each25point branched-cover action to a75point knot-group action with three25point blocks. Every meridian swaps two blocks and fixes the third pointwise. At each source crossing and either twist axis, search for four outside seed arcs whose propagation uses a two-input integer-tangle macro. If the product of the incoming meridian permutations has finite order m, replace that crossing by1+2*m*N crossings for N>=0. Hurwitz periodicity preserves the entire finite image, hence its nonabelian block-stabilizer action and the meridional lower4. The uniform two-input macro gives upper4 for every N.
frozen_local_templates: Exactly13crossings times2axes for each of the four already proved knots. Select the candidate with smallest(product order,crossing index,axis). No293panel expansion, new finite target search or new coefficient field.
distinctness: Compute checkerboard spanning-tree deletion/contraction counts. A single twist replacement is a series or parallel edge expansion; its determinant is affine in the twist length with positive slope. This proves infinitely many distinct knot types rather than merely infinitely many diagrams.
known_family_boundary: Inspect exact checkerboard graphs and primary source scopes. Non-series-parallel alone does not prove a knot nonarborescent: Stoimenow's source explicitly warns about6star exceptions. No classification or novelty conclusion from empty KnotInfo fields, a graph heuristic, or absence from a deposited certificate list.
controls: Independent pointwise meridian relators, block/fixed-sheet checks, noncommuting stabilizer words, independent outside-arc/seed replay, explicit expanded PDs for N=0,1,2, a separately implemented Fox determinant and local tangle propagation tests. Reject a changed meridian, wrong period, invalid outside trace and incorrect determinant coefficient.
scope: Written uniform proof plus finite input certificates. No full MRC, global priority, minimum action degree, full finite image order, all-arborescent classification or specialist/formal verification claim. Preserve old receipts and known failures.
